purpose: Reference pin for every vector in this directory (spec 012 §2; ROADMAP M0).

genosdb.subject: release: 0.37.0 — db.scope: a replica is in parts of the graph, each a room of its own

genossrv.subject: release: 0.12.2 — mirror of genosdb 0.37.0, a difference that comes back is answered with everything

notes: Vector files themselves omit timestamps so double-runs are byte-identical (determinism check).
dirty_files lists uncommitted reference changes present at extraction time; pure-function vectors (hlc, conflict, sm, encoding, query) do not depend on the listed files.
bundle: SHA-256 of the dist files present at extraction time; the published tarball must hash the same for these vectors to describe it.

public.note: A projection of the private conformance vectors, produced by one command: never edited by hand.
